doc.description:
This module is an alternative to the original orange avoider for the course AE4317 Autonomous Flight of Micro Air Vehicles at TU Delft. It uses a potential fields method for obstacle avoidance instead of a state machine. The module processes the outputs of the color filter to compute a repulsive heading adjustment (based on the detected number and location of orange pixels) and updates the drone's heading. It also moves waypoints forward when the path is clear.
The color filter settings are set using the cv_detect_color_object. This module can run multiple filters simultaneously, so you have to define which filter to use with the ORANGE_AVOIDER_PF_VISUAL_DETECTION_ID setting.
